newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel sends air force team to fire in Turkey.
newsitem.headline: Israel sends air force team to fire in Turkey.

text.p: Israel sent an air force team to Turkey on Friday to help battle fires at a munitions plant where explosions forced thousands of residents to flee their homes.
Israel Radio said the team had already reached the site in the town of Kirkkale, central Turkey.

"The government of Turkey appealed to Israel asking for the help of the Israel Air Force in putting out the fire," an army communique said. It said the team took helicopters along with firefighting and rescue equipment.
Israel's military accords with Ankara, which have already meant an exchange of air force training missions, have angered Arab countries formally at war with the Jewish state.
Thousands of Kirikkale residents spent the night outdoors, Turkey's Anatolian news agency said on Friday. A worker at the plant died in hospital, raising the death toll to two.

Blasts that sent flames 1,000 feet (300 metres) into the sky shook the town all day on Thursday, damaging houses and destroying the factory. Flying debris cut dozens of people who were treated in makeshift field clinics.
The Interior Ministry estimated the damage to be at least one trillion Turkish lira ($6.7 million).
